output.description: Assistant messages from the Responses API, with Output Format set to JSON Object or JSON Schema. The structured result is at `$json.output[0].content[0].text` — an ALREADY-PARSED object, not a string. Do not call JSON.parse on it, and never JSON.parse `output` itself (it is an array). There is NO `text` key at the root of `$json`.

type.description: Always `message` — simplified output keeps only message items

text.description: The parsed structured output — the node already ran JSON.parse, so this is an OBJECT whose fields come from the configured JSON schema. It stays a string only when the model returns invalid JSON.
